reading.zh: 从左到右：openai-backend 调远端语义模型，monitors 汇总监控，entity-mapping 映射到实体，descriptor 生成实体描述；箭头是模型输出流向实体描述。
reading.en: Left to right: openai-backend calls the remote semantic model, monitors aggregates telemetry, entity-mapping maps onto entities and descriptor writes the entity description; arrows run from model output to the entity description.
